About Me

I'm a Python-focused software developer with hands-on full-stack experience. I've worked with Django, Flask, React.js, Next.js, and relational databases to build a team-based CRM, a construction marketplace hackathon prototype, and e-commerce applications.

During my software development internship at Upcode Software Labs L.L.P., I contributed to frontend interfaces, backend functionality, and database operations.

I'm currently pursuing an MBA in Data Science and expanding my expertise in Python backend engineering, MySQL, analytics, AI fundamentals, and practical AI integrations.
